title: PB-Atlas arrays-only normalized physical Coble branch

picard_gram.description: Integral symmetric unimodular Picard intersection matrix of signature (1,rho-1).

wall_vectors.description: Primitive effective-oriented wall columns, expressed as row arrays in the chosen Picard basis.

boundary_indices_zero_based.description: Indices of marked anti-bicanonical boundary facet classes.

boundary_weights.description: Positive multiplicities satisfying sum(weight_i*B_i)=-2K; this includes weight 2 for a primitive half-boundary.

canonical_class.description: Integral characteristic canonical vector K in the chosen Picard basis.
